user.title: Connect to Ho-Smart receiver
user.description: Enter the receiver address and your Ho-Smart app credentials. Home Assistant uses the account once during setup to retrieve the receiver's local-control key, then communicates directly with the receiver on your LAN. Your Ho-Smart email and password are not saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Ho-Smart receiver on the local network.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: The Ho-Smart email or password was not accepted.
error.cloud_error: Could not communicate with the Ho-Smart service during setup.
error.no_local_control_devices: The Ho-Smart account did not return any devices with local-control credentials.
error.cannot_match_device: The account devices could not be matched to this receiver. Verify the receiver IP address.

abort.already_configured: This Ho-Smart receiver is already configured.
